## Announcements (May 2026)
- May 7, 2026: AgentCore Payments (preview) — Coinbase + Stripe wallet integration, x402 protocol
- May 6, 2026: AgentCore Runtime bring-your-own file system — attach Amazon S3 Files / Amazon EFS access points directly to agent runtimes; mounted into every session at specified path; standard file operations; requires VPC config + access point ARN
- May 5, 2026: AgentCore available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
- May 1, 2026: AgentCore available in South America (São Paulo) Region
- April 30, 2026: AgentCore Optimization preview (Recommendations + Batch Evaluations + A/B Tests)
